issue.title: Create Empties Returns

labels.name: depends-on:printing
labels.description: Tasks which need to print a document, but printing support is not implemented yet in cypress

issue.body:
**Test shall include:**

- Customer Fixtures to use: (if needed)
- This is about rereturning empty packing material, i.e. the vendor delivered some ordered products, the products were sent inside boxes. Now we give back those boxes to the vendor.

=> In the video i used EUR-Tauschpalette, bc those also exist on customer db; but pls use packing material created for this test (afaik we have fixtures / objects for that already).
- Expectation for the test to be successful
1. new document for Empties Return can be created, in material receipt candidates, right after opening the window (=> no material receipt candidate has to be selected, action is directly available)
2. doctype is set as ~~"Leergutrückgabe"~~ `Leergutausgabe`
3. negative qty can be set as well
    - cannot test due to cypress bug: https://github.com/cypress-io/cypress/issues/2173#issuecomment-512776378 (cypress cannot write `-`)
4. several Returns can be created, for the same bpartner / same packing material
5. docs can be completed (and printed)
(6. in the Jasper doc, the overall sum of all the Returns is displayed correctly, on the correct side. in favour of the bpartner / in favour of metasfresh)


https://recordit.co/YwTQJdiOz5


Todo for developer (besides coding)
- Always make sure the issue is in the correct project lane
- [x] run your test in jenkins e2e on a vanilla db
   - https://dev603.metasfresh.com
- [x] jenkins console URL / cypress dashboard URL to the successful test *suite* run (not just yours)
    - https://dashboard.cypress.io/#/projects/5yp4q1/runs/366/specs -- 3 tests fail but they are unrelated to mine
- [x] get it integrated into `master`
  * [x] https://github.com/metasfresh/metasfresh-e2e/pull/222 (2019-07-22 - ts)

All Flags are ticked? Congratulations, you have delivered!

body:
@TheBestPessimist  

> in v 3.4.0 i can confirm this bug still appears.

0--? That's zero?
0---12345? What?

Please show your Cypress test code or a simple case of a negative number failing

Here's the relevant piece of code: ```javascript cy.get('.form-field-MovementQty') .find('input') .type('{selectall}') .type(`-222`) .type('{enter}'); ``` Here's a gif showing that instead of `-222`, cypress types `222` along with the request sent to the backend: ![cypress minus bug](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4482210/61512017-49b81200-aa01-11e9-8f18-5e4a3dbc6099.gif) Here's the body of the frontend request: `[{"op":"replace","path":"MovementQty","value":"222"}]`, where it should have been `"value": "-222"`. Here's the html of that element: ```html
Bewegungs-Menge
``` --- I have also tried the alternative ```javascript cy.get('.form-field-MovementQty') .find('input') .type('{selectall}') .type(-222) // instead of `-222` .type('{enter}'); ``` but that didnt help either. --- Here's a gif of me typing a negative number in the same field, along with the request sent to the backend: ![e](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/4482210/61512459-aec03780-aa02-11e9-9e0c-1e781724b1c4.gif)
